verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs include an API reference section with Custom Integration Push APIs (Integration Monitoring) and Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs, plus inbound webhooks for pushing data into the platform, so a documented public API exists. Its visible scope looks narrow (data ingestion and some read endpoints), not broad control of the product, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any standard path. Missing for 10: evidence of broad API coverage for driving core workflows (controls, policies, risks, tasks, audits), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, auth/rate-limit documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
